Post-filter to AMD EPYC-class with eff>=16, dph 0.10-0.40, dur>=2 days. The 30-offer snapshot contained 11 qualifying EPYC offers. First selection 36157135 (EPYC 7J13 Taiwan 128 eff cores $0.3614/hr 0.9993 rel) failed in Phase 2: cur_state remained 'stopped' for >15 min after provisioning, vastai start refused with 'Required resources currently unavailable, state change queued' (host capacity issue). Second selection 33356672 (EPYC 7532 California 32 eff cores $0.3260/hr 0.9986 rel) succeeded in ~3 min from create to actual_status=running.

selection_rationale: CPU-only NEURON 8-direction polar re-eval for 10 cells. Plan headroom: $18.35 of $75 project cap remaining; estimated spend ~$0.30-0.50. The task is short (~5-15 min wall) and pure CPU NEURON parallelised across cells with ProcessPoolExecutor max_workers=10. The 30-offer snapshot at 2026-05-18T10:28Z (cpu_cores_effective>=16 cpu_ram>=32 disk_space>=40 reliability>=0.99 dph_total<=0.40 rentable verified) contained 11 EPYC-class offers. Initial pick was offer 36157135 EPYC 7J13 Taiwan 128 eff cores 125.6GB RAM dph 0.3614 reliability 0.9993 -- same Zen-3 Milan family as t0104's successful host. That instance (id 37000045) created at 10:30:36Z but stayed in cur_state=stopped/intended_status=stopped for 15+ minutes with no SSH or container readiness; explicit vastai start returned 'Required resources currently unavailable, state change queued' indicating host capacity exhaustion. Destroyed 37000045 at 10:45:21Z (no work performed, no payload uploaded) and immediately retried with offer 33356672 EPYC 7532 California 32 eff cores 62.8GB RAM dph 0.3260 reliability 0.9986 dur 211.7d -- second-best by reliability and the cheapest of the high-reliability EPYC offers with sufficient cores for a 10-process pool plus headroom. Zen 2 Rome (7532) not Zen 3 Milan, but Zen 2 is fine for this short CPU-only run (NEURON throughput is roughly equivalent at this 1400ms simulation scale). 32 effective cores accommodates the 10-cell parallel pool with ~22 cores of headroom for OS/IO. The selected host actual-billed dph_total is $0.3681/hr (base $0.32 + storage $0.0481), $0.012/hr over the dph_total search-time figure due to storage cost integration; this is 0.07% of the task budget cap and negligible. Reliability 0.9986: for a 25-min run the expected probability of host eviction is ~1 - 0.9986^(25/60*100) ~= 4%, well within risk tolerance for a short job. Alternatives explicitly rejected: 26349246 EPYC 7K62 BC 32 eff cores 41.9GB dph 0.2801 reliability 0.9968 (eff-cores enough, RAM tight but workable, reliability 0.9968 is the lowest of the high-RAM EPYC offers); 24992294 EPYC 7K62 Germany 16 eff cores 83.9GB dph 0.3054 reliability 0.9980 (16 eff cores marginal for 10-pool plus headroom); 36157135 EPYC 7J13 (host capacity failure documented in failed_attempts).
